# Synthetic encoder test input; not a RuleSpec module.
Synthetic encoder test input adapted from relation-roles.md section 8; this is not a RuleSpec module or a full encoding of any provision. The age limits in this shape are 22 and 18. A count greater than 0 flags an exception. Compute the closure exactly through two ties only if no tie leaves that set and no exception may apply; otherwise read caller-supplied household ids with no default. Keep composition and participation separate. Pair facts and one full-period residence record per person are complete, and supplied ids are correct.
